annotations.title: Set What Clients See About You

description: Sets who your clients should contact about their line and one or two sentences on how you work with them. Shown in every client's dashboard. Requires an agency owner or admin. Sends nothing.

clientRelationshipNote.description: How you work with your clients, up to 600 characters; null clears it.

clientSupportContact.description: Email or phone your clients should use; null clears it.
